_note: Shared occupation -> CPL credential crosswalk. Grown by kb/_build_partner_crosswalk.py across partner engagements: each run reports what it could not map (unmapped.json), a curator adds rulings here, and coverage compounds for every future partner. The match is SUBJECT-MATTER JUDGMENT, not an official crosswalk -- partner lists carry job and apprenticeship titles, never credential names.
_schema: occupations: { <normalized occupation key> : { label, credentials:[{title,tier}], partners:[slug], curated_by, curated_at } }. Key = lowercase, punctuation collapsed to single spaces, trimmed -- so "Plumber"/"PLUMBER"/"plumber " share one ruling. tier: D = Direct (the credential IS this occupation's certification/licence), R = Related (commonly held in the occupation, or covers part of the role). title MUST match a unified_title in statewide_data.js / credential_reference_data.js; an empty credentials list is a CURATED FINDING ("no CPL exists for this"), which is different from the occupation being absent from this file ("not yet reviewed").
